data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 卧室单人床上的深情交托
data.description: 温馨静谧的闺房卧室内，淡紫真丝睡裙从雪白香肩滑落床榻。被你拥在怀里的绫濑双颊烧透，眼角噙着幸福的泪花，双手紧紧缠绕在你的脖后，主动献上滚烫的热吻。
data.location: pristine white and pastel decorated girl bedroom
data.action: pinned on white duvet with lavender slip dress sliding off porcelain shoulders, tearful purple eyes gazing up with breathless devotion, arms wrapping around partner neck
data.lighting: dim bedside night lamp casting tender warm shadows on bare model curves
data.mood: emotional romantic consummation, pure possessive surrender, heated lovers embrace
data.promptProse: Pinned on white duvet with lavender slip dress sliding off bare shoulders, Ayase Aragaki wraps arms around partner neck with tearful passionate kisses.
